data.title: Tropical Depression Fay (AT1), advisory 28/2032Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: FAY HOLDING STEADY. As of 5:00 PM AST Mon Sep 28 the center of Fay was located near 26.6, -45.3 with movement SW at 9 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1011 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 35 mph.

data.title: Tropical Storm Hanna (AT3), advisory 28/2040Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: HANNA FORECAST TO BE A SHORT LIVED TROPICAL STORM AS IT MOVES EASTWARD ACROSS THE CENTRAL SUBTROPICAL ATLANTIC. As of 5:00 PM AST Mon Sep 28 the center of Hanna was located near 36.5, -48.7 with movement ESE at 17 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1006 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 45 mph.

data.title: Tropical Storm Rachel (EP3), advisory 28/2040Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: RACHEL MOVING WEST-NORTHWESTWARD PARALLEL TO THE COAST OF MEXICO. As of 3:00 PM CST Mon Sep 28 the center of Rachel was located near 14.2, -102.1 with movement WNW at 10 mph. The minimum central pressure was 999 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 50 mph.

data.title: Hurricane Polo (EP2), advisory 28/2049Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: NOAA HURRICANE HUNTERS INDICATE THAT POLO IS STILL A MAJOR HURRICANE NEARING THE WEST COAST OF BAJA CALIFORNIA SUR. ...LIFE-THREATENING WINDS AND FLASH FLOODING NOW BEGINNING OVER PORTIONS OF BAJA CALIFORNIA SUR... As of 2:00 PM MST Mon Sep 28 the center of Polo was located near 25.0, -113.0 with movement NE at 12 mph. The minimum central pressure was 963 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 115 mph.
